statement: Nonfarm business labour productivity growth in 2027 < 2.5% (Bloc A BLS; annual)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in 2023 (resolves on 2027 data). Context: in 2023 the statistics office reported that annual average productivity fell 1.3% in 2022 (largest drop since 1974), then a strong 2023 rebound (Q2 +3.7%, Q3 +5.2% annualised, revised; +2.4% y/y in Q3), with a 1.5% annual rate over the cycle since 2019Q4 - below the 2.5% threshold.

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office (preliminary): nonfarm business labour productivity rose 3.0% (annualised) in 2022Q4 but fell 1.5% year on year; annual average productivity fell 1.3% from 2021 to 2022, the largest annual decline since 1974.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Fourth Quarter and Annual Averages 2022, Preliminary (USDL 23-0150), 2023-02-02 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office (preliminary): productivity rose 3.7% (annualised) in 2023Q2 as hours fell; +1.3% year on year, the first increase in the four-quarter measure since 2021Q4.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2023, Preliminary (USDL 23-1688), 2023-08-03 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office (preliminary): productivity rose 4.7% (annualised) in 2023Q3, the highest rate since 2020Q3; +2.2% year on year. Data incorporate a comprehensive national-accounts revision.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Third Quarter 2023, Preliminary (USDL 23-2317), 2023-11-02 (verified via web_extract this run; reflects BEA 2023 Comprehensive NIPA Update of 2023-09-28).

items.summary: Bloc A statistics office (revised): 2023Q3 productivity growth revised up to 5.2% (annualised), +2.4% year on year; over the cycle since 2019Q4 productivity grew at a 1.5% annual rate.
items.detail: Bloc A BLS, Productivity and Costs, Third Quarter 2023, Revised (USDL 23-2529), 2023-12-06 (verified via web_extract this run).
